title: Japan–India Energy & Carbon
story: Japan has set a ¥10 trillion India investment target and a live carbon-credit channel (the JCM, rules adopted June 2026). India now pays a fixed ₹2,110/MMBtu for CBG and mandates 3–5% blending. Diverting Mumbai's wet waste from Kanjurmarg into CBG saves roughly 0.4–1.5 t CO₂e per tonne, a fit for JCM co-finance and credits.
